scenes.tts: Does piriform cortex just scatter its input, or does it add something of its own?
scenes.visual: Title card: What the Cortex Adds. The bulb-to-cortex projection with a question mark over the cortex.
scenes.narration: Does piriform cortex just scatter its input, or does it add something of its own?

scenes.tts: Pashkovski and colleagues imaged two things in mice, with the same panel of odours for the comparison.
scenes.visual: Label: Pashkovski and colleagues, 2020. Two imaging windows open side by side.
scenes.narration: Pashkovski and colleagues imaged two things in mice, with the same panel of odours for the comparison.

scenes.tts: First, bulb axon boutons inside piriform cortex. These are the terminals of mitral and tufted cells, the cortex's input.
scenes.visual: Window one: bright axon terminals of mitral and tufted cells within piriform cortex. Label: boutons, the input.
scenes.narration: First, bulb axon boutons inside piriform cortex. These are the terminals of mitral and tufted cells, the cortex's input.

scenes.tts: Second, piriform neurons in layers two and three, the cortex's output.
scenes.caption: Second, piriform neurons in layer 2/3, the cortex's output.
scenes.visual: Window two: piriform layer 2/3 cell bodies. Label: neurons, the output.
scenes.narration: Second, piriform neurons in layer 2/3, the cortex's output.

scenes.tts: The mice breathed at a controlled sniff rate.
scenes.visual: A steady sniff waveform runs along the bottom of the screen.
scenes.narration: The mice breathed at a controlled sniff rate.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. If piriform followed our simple random model, how should related odours compare between boutons and cortex?
scenes.visual: Two empty similarity matrices, labelled boutons and piriform, with odour groups marked along the edges. On screen: tighter, same, or looser?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. If piriform followed our simple random model, how should related odours compare between boutons and cortex?

scenes.visual: the question stays on screen

scenes.tts: By that model, the cortex should largely keep the bulb's relationships. Related odours should be less alike than in the input, not more.
scenes.visual: A dashed outline on the piriform matrix: blocks softer than the bouton blocks.
scenes.narration: By that model, the cortex should largely keep the bulb's relationships. Related odours should be less alike than in the input, not more.

scenes.tts: The first half held. In boutons and in cortex, related odours gave more similar patterns than unrelated ones.
scenes.visual: Both matrices fill in: related-odour groups appear as brighter blocks along the diagonal.
scenes.narration: The first half held. In boutons and in cortex, related odours gave more similar patterns than unrelated ones.

scenes.tts: The scattered cortex kept the chemistry.
scenes.visual: Label: chemistry kept in both.
scenes.narration: The scattered cortex kept the chemistry.

scenes.tts: The second half did not hold. Piriform neurons clustered related odours more tightly than their own input did.
scenes.visual: The piriform blocks sharpen beyond the dashed outline; the bouton blocks stay softer.
scenes.narration: The second half did not hold. Piriform neurons clustered related odours more tightly than their own input did.

scenes.tts: Made-up numbers on screen show the direction. The cortex value sits above the input value.
scenes.visual: On screen, marked made-up example for selected related pairs, not measured averages: boutons 0.4, piriform 0.7.
scenes.narration: Made-up numbers on screen show the direction. The cortex value sits above the input value.

scenes.tts: The authors also fed their bouton data through a random-wiring model. It kept the order, but made the patterns less alike.
scenes.visual: A third matrix labelled random model: the same block order as the boutons, with softer blocks.
scenes.narration: The authors also fed their bouton data through a random-wiring model. It kept the order, but made the patterns less alike.

scenes.tts: So something in the cortex added structure that the random model did not give.
scenes.visual: Label: the cortex added structure.
scenes.narration: So something in the cortex added structure that the random model did not give.

scenes.tts: This is a different kind of map. A spatial map puts similar odours in nearby places.
scenes.visual: Left panel: a spatial map with similar odours in neighbouring patches.
scenes.narration: This is a different kind of map. A spatial map puts similar odours in nearby places.

scenes.tts: A representational geometry gives similar odours similar population patterns, wherever the cells sit.
scenes.visual: Right panel: scattered cells, with similar odours lighting similar sets of them.
scenes.narration: A representational geometry gives similar odours similar population patterns, wherever the cells sit.

scenes.tts: Piriform cortex has the second without the first.
scenes.visual: The left panel greys out with a cross; the right panel glows. Label: representational geometry.
scenes.narration: Piriform cortex has the second without the first.

scenes.tts: What could add the structure? Piriform pyramidal cells, its main excitatory neurons, are linked to each other by association fibres.
scenes.visual: Association fibres draw in between scattered piriform cells.
scenes.narration: What could add the structure? Piriform pyramidal cells, its main excitatory neurons, are linked to each other by association fibres.

scenes.tts: These are recurrent connections within the cortex. Reviews treat them as a place where experience is stored.
scenes.visual: The fibres loop back among the cells. Label: recurrent connections, thought to store experience.
scenes.narration: These are recurrent connections within the cortex. Reviews treat them as a place where experience is stored.

scenes.tts: Strengthening synapses among neurons that are active together is thought to bind a scattered ensemble into a familiar odour.
scenes.visual: Fibres between co-active cells thicken; the ensemble is outlined as one odour object.
scenes.narration: Strengthening synapses among neurons that are active together is thought to bind a scattered ensemble into a familiar odour.

scenes.tts: Then the whole ensemble could respond even when part of the input is missing. This is pattern completion.
scenes.visual: Half the inputs drop out, yet the full ensemble lights. Label: pattern completion.
scenes.narration: Then the whole ensemble could respond even when part of the input is missing. This is pattern completion.

scenes.tts: Pashkovski's team tested the network directly. A genetic tool blocked transmitter release from excitatory piriform neurons.
scenes.visual: A piriform cell with its output synapse dimmed. Label: excitatory output blocked.
scenes.narration: Pashkovski's team tested the network directly. A genetic tool blocked transmitter release from excitatory piriform neurons.

scenes.tts: Their bulb input still arrived, so they still responded. But they excited their neighbours, including inhibitory cells, much less.
scenes.visual: The bulb input arrow into the cell stays bright; the fibres to excitatory and inhibitory neighbours fade.
scenes.narration: Their bulb input still arrived, so they still responded. But they excited their neighbours, including inhibitory cells, much less.

scenes.tts: Pause and predict. With the network weakened, what should happen to the cortex's odour relationships?
scenes.visual: A third, empty matrix labelled piriform, output blocked. On screen: what happens to the blocks?
scenes.narration: Pause and predict. With the network weakened, what should happen to the cortex's odour relationships?

scenes.visual: the question stays on screen

scenes.tts: Its odour relationships became more like the bulb's.
scenes.visual: Schematic: the third matrix regroups some blocks to match the bouton matrix. No numbers on screen.
scenes.narration: Its odour relationships became more like the bulb's.

scenes.tts: Responses did not simply weaken. Tuning broadened and correlations rose overall, yet the pattern moved toward the bulb's.
scenes.visual: Two tags: broader tuning, higher correlations overall. An arrow points from the third matrix to the bouton matrix: relationships closer.
scenes.narration: Responses did not simply weaken. Tuning broadened and correlations rose overall, yet the pattern moved toward the bulb's.

scenes.tts: One caveat. Piriform also sends feedback to the bulb, and connects to other olfactory areas.
scenes.visual: Arrows from piriform back to the bulb and out to other olfactory areas.
scenes.narration: One caveat. Piriform also sends feedback to the bulb, and connects to other olfactory areas.

scenes.tts: So piriform network activity is needed for the change. It is not shown that local connections alone produce it.
scenes.visual: Label: network activity needed; local connections alone not shown.
scenes.narration: So piriform network activity is needed for the change. It is not shown that local connections alone produce it.

scenes.tts: The cortex keeps the bulb's chemistry, then reshapes it with its own network.
scenes.visual: Takeaway card: the cortex keeps the chemistry, and its network reshapes it.
scenes.narration: The cortex keeps the bulb's chemistry, then reshapes it with its own network.
